Wraith-like, skeletal dragon. Spawned from drakes that resented death and dying. Lurk near their lairs, slaying and reveling in undeath.

AC 14, HP 58, ATK 3 rend +7 (2d10 + dispel divine) or 1 death breath, MV double near (fly), S -4, D +4, C +4, I +3, W +3, Ch +5, AL C, LV 12

Death Breath. Fills a double near-sized cube extending from wyrmwraith. DEX 15+ or 4d6 damage. Creatures slain by breath rise as shadows.

Dispel Divine. Divine magic on target is dispelled.

Greater Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Incorporeal. In place of attacks, become corporeal or incorporeal.

Light Vulnerability. Powerless in bright light, can only take a move action.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
